name: PayCall hotline data
description: Official customer-service and government hotline numbers (countries: Australia, Canada, Germany, France, United Kingdom, Ireland, Mexico, and United States), each with the organisation's own source and check date; whether PayCall calls from abroad connected, with the last date; what each line says first, recorded by PayCall's test robot; phone-menu routes to a person tested with real calls; and measured hold times. Published by PayCall, Inc. for AI assistants and developers.

license.name: CC BY 4.0
license.scope: The hotline data in this file: numbers, hours, sources, test results, phone-menu routes and measured times. The texts of PayCall's websites are not covered.

howToCite: Free to reuse, also commercially, with a credit and link to PayCall (pay-call.com/hotlines.json). Cite the organisation's own source URL for numbers and hours, and PayCall with the test date for test results, routes and measured times.

lookup.byNumber: https://pay-call.com/hotlines.json?number=+18008291040 (any format; main or other numbers of a hotline)
lookup.filters: https://pay-call.com/hotlines.json?country=gb&kind=bank&status=tested (country: au, ca, de, fr, gb, ie, mx, us; kind: government, bank, finance, insurance, airline, hotel, car-rental, telecom, tech, shipping, other; status: tested, checked or listed; abroad=confirmed: only hotlines reached from abroad)
lookup.language: https://pay-call.com/hotlines.json?lang=es (texts in en, de, fr, es, it, pt, nl, pl, ja, zh, ar; English where a translation is missing)

methods.source: Number and hours as published by the organisation itself; source.type number-page: an official page that lists the number, website: the organisation's site where the number page is not confirmed yet.
methods.reachableFromAbroad: A call through PayCall, a browser calling service used from abroad, connected to the hotline (main or other number) on lastConfirmedOn and no call was refused by the network since. The caller's location is not stored. Many toll-free numbers can't be dialled from a foreign phone.
methods.lastTestCall: PayCall's test robot calls each hotline about once a month, listens without pressing anything and records what the line says first. firstAnnouncement is a summary of the recognised speech, not a recording or transcript.
methods.route: method robot: the test robot walked the phone menu towards a person without ever entering account or ID data; published only after two tests in a row ended the same way (confirmedOn). method manual: written down from a test call by a person.
methods.measured: Measured on PayCall calls of at least one minute: waitOnHold is the time Hold for me (microphone off) was on, callLength the whole call. Range and median, not a promise.
methods.estimate: Set by PayCall where measurements are missing or misleading.

fields.status: tested: a phone-menu route (to a person, or a tested dead end) is on record; checked: the test robot called the line and recorded what it says first; listed: taken from the organisation's own source only.
fields.hours: text: the organisation's own wording; schedule: { timeZone (IANA), days (mon…sun), opens, closes (local 24-hour time) } where known, else null.
fields.lastTestCall: testedAt (UTC), number, heard (menu, private, queue, closed or message), firstAnnouncement, options (keys heard), asksFirstFor (data asked for first), voiceAssistant, language. null until a test call reached the line.
fields.route: result: queue (hold queue for an agent), person, private (no way to a person without account or ID data) or closed; steps: the keys pressed and words said from the start; wayOut: words the line offers instead of account data that worked; triedWithoutSuccess: data-free ways out that did not help; secondsToPerson; confirmedOn (newest first). null until tested.
fields.waitOnHold: lowMinutes, highMinutes, medianMinutes, method (measured or estimate); null until measured.
fields.callLength: Same shape and rules as waitOnHold, for the whole call.
fields.lastTestedOn: Date of the newest test call that reached the line.
fields.lastChangedOn: Newest date anything in the record was checked or changed: source check, test call, call from abroad or route.
